audience: finance and support teams who manage subscriptions and invoices in Chargebee

useCases.title: List active subscriptions and their customers
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriptions filtered by status or customer and opens the related customers, so you see who is subscribed and what each subscription looks like.

useCases.title: Find unpaid or overdue invoices
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices filtered by status or customer and summarizes which ones still need attention, so you know what to follow up on.

useCases.title: Review the payments and refunds of one customer
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by email, then lists their transactions and credit notes, so you get one view of payments, refunds and credits.

useCases.title: Compare plans, add-ons, prices and coupons
useCases.text: The AI lists Product Catalog 2.0 items by type, their item prices and your coupons, so you can see what you sell and which coupons exist.

useCases.title: Find, create or update a customer
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by email and updates their details, such as a phone number. It can also create a new customer when none exists.
